app.name: WordWise
app.description: Learn vocabulary and remember it with smart review scheduling.

today.emptyBody: Add a word you just came across, or pick a ready-made set for your goal.

words.title: My words
words.emptyBody: Words you add will live in your notebooks here.

practice.title: Practice

stats.title: Stats
stats.emptyBody: Finish your first review session to see your progress.

settings.languageHint: Changes right away, no reload needed.

welcome.tagline: Learn English vocabulary and remember it with smart review scheduling.

auth.finishFailed: Sign-in didn't finish. Your data on this device is safe, please try again.
auth.needsJavascript: JavaScript is required to sign in.

file.needAccount: Sign in to import from files.
